verses.text: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:

segments.text: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:

verses.text: I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”

verses.text: I said, “I will never again see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living; I will no longer look on mankind with those who dwell in this world.

verses.text: My dwelling has been picked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver; He cuts me off from the loom; from day until night You make an end of me.
